page_title: ARS 4-2 LEI | Arsenal v Leicester 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+10' The Arsenal players joy may have been justified, because referee Samuel Barrott is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
90+9' 4 - 2 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Kai Havertz (Arsenal), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 4:2.
90+9' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90+9' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Mads Hermansen pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
90+8' The substitution has been made. Issahaku Fatawu (Leicester) has replaced Caleb Okoli.
90+8' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Wilfred Ndidi is replaced by Odsonne Edouard (Leicester).
90+8' Substitution. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Leandro Trossard walks off.
90+7' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle.
90+4' 3 - 2 OWN GOAL! Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 3:2.
90+4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
90+4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
90+2' Jordan Ayew (Leicester) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
90+1' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid.
90+1' Substitution. Oliver Skipp walks off the pitch and Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) comes on as a substitute.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
89' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
89' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mads Hermansen is well positioned and punches the ball away.

89' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

88' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The linesman points to the corner flag, Arsenal are going to take it.
88' The referee awards a corner and Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take it.
87' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Arsenal.
87' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
86' Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Mads Hermansen.
85' Mikel Arteta has decided to make a change. Ethan Nwaneri (Arsenal) replaces Thomas Partey.
85' Facundo Buonanotte goes off the pitch and Jordan Ayew (Leicester) comes on.
84' Gabriel (Arsenal) tries to find Declan Rice, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
82' Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
82' Mads Hermansen (Leicester) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
82' The attendance for today's match is 60323.
80' The game is interrupted now, Mads Hermansen (Leicester) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
79' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
77' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.

75' Mads Hermansen was forced into action to thwart Gabriel (Arsenal). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
74' Declan Rice (Arsenal) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mads Hermansen reads it well and gathers the ball.
74' It's time for a substitution. Raheem Sterling (Arsenal) comes on in place of Gabriel Martinelli.

74' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
73' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Mads Hermansen stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
73' Declan Rice floats a good corner into the box that Gabriel (Arsenal) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just over the bar.
73' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is about to take a corner kick.

72' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
70' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) duly receives a yellow card.

70' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) brings his opponent down. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Leicester will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
70' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

69' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Well-positioned Kai Havertz (Arsenal) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Mads Hermansen reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
68' The resulting corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

67' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
67' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take the corner.
67' A lofted cross from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Arsenal get a corner.
63' 2 - 2 Goal! James Justin (Leicester) fires a first-time effort from inside the penalty area into the left side of the goal, glancing in off the post. What a finish!
61' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
58' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) smashed a volley without hesitation from near the penalty spot, but it only rattled the right post!
56' A sweet pass inside the box gives Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
55' Bukayo Saka races towards the box before laying off to Kai Havertz (Arsenal), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
53' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.

53' What a great chance for Gabriel (Arsenal). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) reacts superbly inside the box to get first to the rebound. From about the penalty spot he produces a header towards the right post, but Mads Hermansen pulls off a magnificent save to keep the ball out of the net.
52' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

52' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
52' The resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared by the defence.
51' Thomas Partey (Arsenal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Arsenal.
50' It's like he was asking for a caution. Oliver Skipp (Leicester) receives a yellow card.
49' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Samuel Barrott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

47' 2 - 1 James Justin (Leicester) outjumps the defence in the centre of the box and connects with the free kick from Facundo Buonanotte. He sends the ball inside the left post with his towering header and alters the score to 2:1.
46' William Saliba (Arsenal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45+3' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Samuel Barrott to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Arsenal players can finally celebrate.
45+3' Wait! Referee Samuel Barrott has indicated he is going to review the Arsenal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

45+1' 2 - 0 Sensational! Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the bottom of the right post and into the net. The assist goes to Gabriel Martinelli and the score changes to 2:0.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Arsenal hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
41' The corner kick from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
41' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
37' Leandro Trossard sets up Kai Havertz (Arsenal) with a lofted pass in the centre of the box, but his header flies just wide of the right post.
36' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Thomas Partey (Arsenal). Samuel Barrott saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
34' Declan Rice (Arsenal) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
34' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends the corner into the box, but Mads Hermansen intercepts it and averts the threat.
33' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
32' Declan Rice (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
31' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:1. The current number of shots on goal is 4:0.
27' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
27' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Declan Rice (Arsenal) took the corner.

26' This should have been a goal! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) sends a killer pass into the box, but Gabriel Martinelli can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession. Arsenal force their opponents to concede a corner.
25' Mads Hermansen pulls off a great save to deny Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
25' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) finds himself some space and fires in a superb first-time shot from long distance low towards the middle of the goal. Mads Hermansen makes a good save to deny him.
24' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
24' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. Arsenal win a free kick.
23' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

22' Declan Rice (Arsenal) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
21' Steven Cooper isn't happy on the touchline after referee Samuel Barrott shows him a yellow card.
21' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.

20' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Jurrien Timber, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), who beats Mads Hermansen with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
17' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' CHANCE! Bukayo Saka finds Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar!
15' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Mads Hermansen.
14' Arsenal players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
13' Jurrien Timber (Arsenal) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
13' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
12' Declan Rice (Arsenal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
10' Mads Hermansen comes off his line to intercept the corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
9' The free kick is taken short by Arsenal.
8' Oliver Skipp (Leicester) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick is awarded to Arsenal.
5' He should have scored! James Justin (Leicester) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
4' Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' The ball is cleared after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Leicester will kick-off.
Samuel Barrott is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
